第一卷 第647章 您真的了解她吗（第1页）
叶秋雨没看台下，也没留意其他人的反应，也没有给林芜开口的机会。
听到陆博士的话，他讽刺一笑：“哦？是吗？是什么让陆博士您这么认为？是您看了她发表的那些论文，是您刚才和她聊过了，确认了她能力确实足够出众？”
陆博士正想说是，叶秋雨却看着他，不给他开口机会的继续说道：“但您确定您真的足够了解她了？确定她真的有您以为的那么优秀？”
台下众人一开始看着这一幕，其实大部分人都挺懵的，不知道这是怎么回事。
不过，现场大部分人，不管是不是ai圈的，也不管他们知不知道容辞发表那些论文意味着什么，她获得的奖又意味着什么，但他们大部分人却都知道，长墨现在主要由容辞和郁默勋两人主持大局。
容辞能做到这一点，听说是因为在合作中，她提供的技术支持和解决问题的能力一点都不比郁默勋差。
所以很多和她合作过的技术大佬，都非常喜欢容辞，也都对容辞的能力赞不绝口。
也就是说，容辞的能力确实是非常出众的。
陆博士想要收她成为自己的学生，他们都觉得没什么问题。
至于这封总的女朋友……除了封总女朋友的身份，好像没有听说她能力有多突出啊？
要是她能力和容辞一样突出，她应该早就跟容辞一样，成为封总的左膀右臂了吧？
所以，看着眼前这一幕，不少人都觉得是林芜不甘心不能成为陆博士的学生，特意让人闹的。
可现在听着，怎么好像不是那么一回事？
陆博士自然也听出来叶秋雨话中有话了。
叶秋雨笑了下，这时，他才看向了台下，看向了容辞和郁默勋，说道：“大家可能不知道，曾经，我也是长墨的员工。”
叶秋雨这话一出，众人惊愕地“哇”了一声。
他们真的没想到叶秋雨居然在长墨工作过。

可叶秋雨没有给任何人机会，很快就收回了落在容辞和郁默勋身上的视线，看着陆博士继续说道：“我当初会进入长墨，是因为长墨那套编程语言。
共事的那些日子，在我的心里，我一直以为郁总是一个热爱ai，是一个非常有创造性，也很纯粹的人。直到有一天，我学妹说说她也想进入长墨……因为他也对长墨那套编程语言非常感兴趣，正好我也觉得跟在郁总身边，能让我们有所成长，所以，我就郁总介绍了给我学妹认识。”
“见面那天，本来一切都好好的，郁总对我学妹也很满意，毕竟……我学妹可是14岁就考上了大学，后来还成功考上世界前三的大学，轻松成为了史密夫先生手下的博士生——这个履历，说我学妹是一个天才，应该不为过吧？”
叶秋雨还没说完，台下众人就已经明白叶秋雨口中的学妹，似乎就是林芜了。
同时，台下也响起了一阵阵的震惊和惊叹声。
他们知道林芜好像是挺厉害的，但具体如何，还真了解得不多。
现在听叶秋雨这么说，他们才发现，林芜确实很牛，也忽然能明白，为什么封庭深对她这么好，这么爱她了。

Volume 1 Chapter 647 Do you really know her (Page 1)
Ye Qiuyu didn't look at the audience, didn't pay attention to other people's reactions, and didn't give Lin Wu a chance to speak.
Hearing Dr. Lu's words, he smiled sarcastically: "Oh? Really? What makes you think so, Dr. Lu? Did you read the papers she published? Did you just talk to her and confirm that her abilities are indeed outstanding enough?"
Dr. Lu was about to say yes, but Ye Qiuyu looked at him and continued without giving him a chance to speak: "But are you sure you really know her well enough? Are you sure she is really as good as you think?"
When everyone in the audience watched this scene at first, most of them were actually quite confused and didn't know what was going on.
However, most of the people at the scene, whether they were in the AI ​​industry or not, and whether they knew what it meant for Rong Ci to publish those papers and what the award she won meant, but most of them knew that Chang Mo was now mainly run by Rong Ci and Yu Moxun.
Rong Ci was able to do this, I heard, because during the cooperation, the technical support and problem-solving abilities she provided were no worse than Yu Moxun.
Therefore, many technical experts who have worked with her like Rong Ci very much and are full of praise for Rong Ci's ability.
In other words, Rong Ci's ability is indeed outstanding.
Dr. Lu wanted to accept her as his student, and they all thought there was no problem.
As for Mr. Feng’s girlfriend... apart from being Mr. Feng’s girlfriend, I don’t seem to have heard of how outstanding her abilities are?
If her abilities were as outstanding as Rong Ci's, she should have become Mr. Feng's right-hand man just like Rong Ci, right?
Therefore, looking at the scene in front of them, many people felt that Lin Wu was unwilling to become Dr. Lu's student and deliberately caused trouble.
But now listen, why doesn't it seem like that?
Dr. Lu naturally heard that there was something in Ye Qiuyu's words.
Ye Qiuyu smiled. At this time, he looked at the audience, looked at Rong Ci and Yu Moxun, and said, "You may not know that I was once an employee of Chang Mo."
As soon as Ye Qiuyu said these words, everyone let out a "wow" in shock.
They really didn't expect that Ye Qiuyu actually worked in Changmo.
But Ye Qiuyu didn't give anyone a chance, and quickly withdrew his gaze from Rong Ci and Yu Moxun, looked at Dr. Lu and continued: "I entered Chang Mo because of Chang Mo's programming language.
During those days when we worked together, in my heart, I always thought that Yu always loved AI and was a very creative and pure person. Until one day, my junior classmate said that she also wanted to join Changmo... because he was also very interested in Changmo's programming language. I just happened to think that being with Mr. Yu would help us grow, so I introduced Mr. Yu to my junior schoolgirl. "
"On the day we met, everything was fine, and Mr. Yu was also very satisfied with my junior sister. After all...my junior sister was admitted to university at the age of 14, and later successfully entered one of the top three universities in the world, and easily became a doctoral student under Mr. Smith. With this resume, it is not an exaggeration to say that my junior sister is a genius, right?"
Before Ye Qiuyu finished speaking, everyone in the audience already understood that the school girl Ye Qiuyu mentioned seemed to be Lin Wu.
At the same time, there were waves of shock and exclamation from the audience.
They knew that Lin Wu seemed to be quite powerful, but they really didn't know much about the specifics.
Now when they heard what Ye Qiuyu said, they realized that Lin Wu was really awesome, and they suddenly understood why Feng Tingshen was so good to her., love her so much.
